name: v1.5.6 release
body:
## Verify your download

Every asset below is listed in `SHA256SUMS`. Download it next to them and run:

    sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS      # macOS: shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS

Windows PowerShell has no `-c` equivalent; compare a single file with
`Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 <file>`.

```
21b1042105d9a757328ba8e55c4e228cd32995a30bbe4c3e92722399c482c74a  oxchat-1.5.6-linux-x64.tar.gz
fe5adc5a3743c5eb6b7b912e58eee7d29bd23ff9c6f2b9bc3d40e6d4e64e8869  oxchat-1.5.6-macos.zip
c1d05e334501f76ecbc0b796941f91cc3f581c08a7d77e6512965af9cc050f24  oxchat-1.5.6-windows-x64-setup.exe
b7b49a41606fa26af8508ca12af7b00fa1ae151d8d185b3851292c3b20c3323e  oxchat-1.5.6-windows-x64.zip
e9c1f2c474115bf71df0c10352c72668aae5489370c43bd0fe5d27c2e1bc1cf3  oxchat-play-signed-109.apk
```

## What's Changed
* [fix] Add 'Disabled' sound option & clean up .gitmodules (#66)
* fix: block HTTP/WS connections when Tor proxy is configured but not r… (#67)
* fix: block system-proxy leak and validate TLS certs for non-onion hosts (#69)
* ci: package Android and desktop builds, and fix what blocked them (#71)
* fix: stop the app aborting at launch without an audio backend (#82)
* fix: correct the SOCKS proxy address type (#75)
* fix: stop a failed account login from wiping the logged in account (#74)
* fix: stop notifying the user about their own messages (#77)
* ci: publish to Play and fetch back the Play-signed APK (#83)
* ci: publish SHA-256 checksums with every release asset (#79)
* ci: build the Windows installer from source (#80)
* chore: drop the dead flutter_sound package, and fix the macOS build (#78)
* chore: finish the monorepo consolidation (#81)
* fix: stop re-initiating the NIP-55 signer connection on every app start (#76)
* fix: install libunwind-dev so the Linux job can resolve gstreamer (#84)
* ci: cache Gradle and pub so builds stop starting from cold (#85)
* ci: ship the Play-signed APK in the release, not one built here (#86)
* fix(ci): give Windows a native PUB_CACHE path so pub can resolve git deps (#88)
* chore: bump to 1.5.6+109 for the next release (#90)
* fix: security fixes for Cashu P2PK oracle, gift-wrap forgery, config redirect, WebView signing (#92)

## Also in this release

These changes went into `main` directly rather than through pull requests, so they are not in the list above.

### Security & privacy
- Release builds no longer write logs to the device console. Some log lines could include upload credentials, purchase receipts, the Cashu database password and freshly created ecash tokens.
- Framework errors are reported again, and the opt-in developer log (the one you can send from Settings) records errors again.

### Reliability
- Failed zap, ecash and text sends now show an error instead of failing silently. A text message that fails to send stays in the input box, and sharing a Cashu token from the wallet stays on the page so the token can be copied again.
- Relay reconnects back off (from 3 s up to 5 min) instead of retrying every 3 s forever, and duplicate reconnect loops are gone.
- Subscriptions no longer get stuck after a relay reconnects, and requests sent while a relay is still connecting are delivered once it is up.
- Switching accounts no longer piles up relay listeners that re-subscribed everything several times.
- Wallet: unexpected swap errors are shown, and a failed mint lookup no longer blocks that mint until the app restarts.
- Screens no longer keep text fields, animations and listeners alive after they are closed, and closing the ecash dialog during a redeem no longer disturbs the page underneath.

### Performance
- Faster start: auto-login now runs while the launch animation plays, with the key decryption off the UI thread.
- Smoother chats: the message list no longer rebuilds on every keyboard animation frame or on unrelated updates, and the chat list keeps its rows when sessions update.
- Less data and battery: video messages no longer re-fetch the video when scrolled back into view, avatars get their own cache, and the start-up profile sync is batched.
- Less work at start-up and on resume: the event cache loads only ids, database lookups use their indexes, and returning to the foreground no longer spawns extra background isolates.
- Large uploads are hashed off the UI thread.

### Size
- About 6 MB smaller: oversized images were resized and unused fonts removed. The unused `just_audio` plugin is no longer bundled.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/0xchat-app/0xchat-app-main/compare/v1.5.5-release...v1.5.6-release

name: v1.5.5 release
body:
- Fixed image upload on Windows/Linux; image and voice uploads are faster and more reliable
- Default to Blossom/Originless and auto-switch when the user-specified server is down or unavailable
- Multi-level fallback for profile pictures — no more empty avatars
- Moved relay count to the right side
- Deferred Isar DB close to fix account-switch crash
- One-tap clear app cache and cookies
- Fixed a batch of Linux and Windows compatibility issues
- Max voice message duration: 3 minutes
- FileDrop set as default file server
- Removed 0xchat-core submodule; code integrated into 0xchat-app-main
- Docker support: build and run on Linux out of the box

name: v1.5.4 release
body:
# 0xchat v1.5.4 Release Notes

## Linux Fixes

* Fixed AppImage not showing the **0xchat icon in the Ubuntu Dock**.
* Fixed incorrect **version number displayed in the “Me” tab**.
* Fixed layout issue on **Create Passcode** page where the bottom row was cut off.
* Fixed issue where **images sent via links appeared extremely large** in chat.
* Fixed issue where **emoji reactions appeared as monochrome symbols** instead of colored emoji.
* Fixed issue where **Logout would reopen the app instead of exiting**.
* Fixed freezes when **adding emoji reactions**.
* Fixed issue where **context menus could get stuck and not close**.
* Fixed issue where after clicking **Reply / Copy in private chats**, the UI became unresponsive.
* Fixed issue where the **Translate context menu could freeze the interface**.

## App Fixes

* Fixed **image upload issues**.
* Fixed issue where **relay entries sometimes could not be deleted**.
* Fixed issues related to **npub.cash**.
* Fixed **0xchat mint recharge** issues.
* Fixed issue where **profile upload might fail when creating an account for the first time**.
* Improved behavior when **long-pressing media files in Android NApp browser**.
* Added **video volume settings**.
* Added new relays:

  * [https://nostr.data.haus/](https://nostr.data.haus/)
  * [https://relay.mostr.pub/](https://relay.mostr.pub/)
* Added **voice playback improvements**:

  * scrolling playback
  * 2× playback speed

name: v1.5.3 release
body:
- Added automatic draft saving for Moments
- Fixed issues with tag-based topic search.

- Fixed issues to fully comply with the NIP-55 specification.

name: v1.5.0.95 release
body:
1. Built-in Tor SDK — now supports accessing onion relays and Cashu mints.
2. NIP-17 DMs — message delivery status view added.
3. Redesigned Discover tab — introducing NApps, with NIP-07 for seamless access to Nostr web apps.
4. NIP-28 Channels are back — create and search for channels once again.

The vision for 0xchat is now crystal clear: feature-rich and full of fun — NIP-17 DMs & groups, NIP-28 channels, NIP-29 groups, audio & video calls, moments, NApps, and Cashu wallets.

Nothing can stop the progress! 🚀

name: v1.4.7 beta
body:
# **v1.4.7-beta**

## **Major Updates**
- Upgraded the Flutter framework to **v3.29.0**.
- Private chat implementation changed to **NIP-104 Nostr MLS**.

## **Other Updates**
- NIP-17 and NIP-29 messages now support `q` tags.
- You can swipe left to reply on your own messages.
- Chat messages now support code block display.
- Copy images from the clipboard.
- Fixed an issue where underlined text in chat appeared as italic.

## **Notice**
**NIP-104 MLS is still in beta and should be used for testing purposes only.**  
Future optimizations for MLS-104 implementation will include:  
- NIP-17 private groups will transition to MLS private groups.  
- Implementation of key package rotation mechanism.
- Support for adding and removing members in group chats without creating a new group.

![secret chat](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/efab3170-d1ee-400e-9561-862da57e26db)

name: v1.3.1 release
body:
**v1.3.1 Release Notes**

This release incorporates changes from previous beta versions. Compared to v1.3.0 release, the complete change log is as follows:

### New Features:
- Microphone access is now only requested during voice calls.
- Added an "Always Use Relay" option for voice/video calls to protect IP addresses.
- Voice calls can now continue in background mode.
- Multi-account switching is now supported.
- Added tips for auto-deleting conversations.
- Improved the experience of sending images and videos in chats.
- `@` mentions are now supported in relay groups.
- Added a join request entry for groups.
- Merged groups and channels in the contacts list.
- Added push notifications for group messages, likes, and replies.
- The discovery page now supports searching for groups by group ID, relay host, or naddr.
- Group admins can now delete messages for everyone.

### Performance Enhancements and Bug Fixes:
- Optimized database access to boost app performance.
- Improved badge display speed.
- Enhanced coin selection algorithm for faster ecash transactions.
- Fixed issues where images and videos in chats were not displaying.
- Resolved a bug with custom NIP96 servers.
- Fixed issues with replying to or liking group notes.
- Addressed incomplete loading of reactions and zaps in messages.
- Fixed incorrect hashtag display.
- Resolved issues with group join/leave notifications not refreshing.
- Fixed several UI issues in light mode.
- Fixed a crash when sending videos on Android.
- Reduced app memory consumption and optimized performance on certain Android devices.
- Optimized encryption and decryption event lag.
- Enabled single-click on a tab to scroll the list to the top.
- Displayed a default background while images and videos load.
- Improved the experience of sending images and videos.
- Fixed issues with push notifications not disabling after logout.
- Fixed user badge refresh issues.
- Resolved loading issues with the follow list.
- Corrected wallet balance display after switching accounts.
- Fixed duplicated mint lists after switching accounts.
- Addressed app freezes and disconnections when switching accounts.
- Resolved mixing of secret chats with regular DMs.
- Fixed issues with deleting conversations with strangers.
- Corrected group QR code scanning problems.
- Fixed Nostr scheme parsing issues.
- Resolved push notification settings not taking effect.
- Fixed profile picture setting issues.
- The "Always Use Relay" option now defaults to off.
- Fixed database backup and restore failures.
- Addressed various message reaction issues.
